verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents one partitioning API, callable via the Python SDK or REST, that accepts 65+ file types and returns a single consistent JSON element format. Auto mode routes each page to a suitable strategy, so the developer does not need per-format plumbing. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party list confirming DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, image and email formats specifically (only PDFs, forms and scans are named), and independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed-format handling.
